title: Balbala, the Traitor Boss Guide: Poison Gas, Coin Runes and the Ascendancy Unlock
summary: Path of Exile 2 Act 2 boss guide: Balbala's poison gas vanish, coin runes, Spectral Blades, and how Balbala's Barya unlocks the Trial of the Sekhemas for your first Ascendancy.
description: Beat Balbala, the Traitor in PoE2 Act 2 Traitor's Passage. Find her in the poison cloud, cancel coin runes, and claim Balbala's Barya to start the Trial of the Sekhemas for Ascendancy Points.
location: Traitor's Passage (Prison of the Disgraced), Act 2
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team

sections.title: Remember These First
sections.callout: Balbala, the Traitor is the Act 2 Traitor's Passage boss whose kill drops Balbala's Barya — the quest item that opens the Trial of the Sekhemas and grants your first Ascendancy Points.
calloutDetail: She vanishes into a spreading poison gas; you must locate and approach her to force her out.
Coin runes she tosses spawn a Spirit of Balbala unless you roll through the coin to cancel it.
The Barya only drops if you have not yet completed the first Trial — it is not repeatable.

answers.label: Main damage
answers.text: Physical, Chaos and Fire, plus Poison

answers.label: First step
answers.text: Find her inside the poison cloud, then cancel coins

answers.label: The reward
answers.text: Balbala's Barya -> Trial of the Sekhemas -> Ascendancy Points

answers.label: If no Barya
answers.text: You already earned it, or the Trial quest is done

items.question: Where is Balbala in Traitor's Passage?
answer: Past the Six Sisters staircase, follow the paper seals to the Ancient Seal door, open it, then remove the 3 Runic Seals in the Prison of the Disgraced to release her. The fight starts immediately.

items.question: Why can't I see her during the fight?
answer: She turns invisible and spreads poison gas from the arena center (cue: 'Visions of Jarah!'). Contagion or any damaging ailment VFX reveals her position; walk into her to force the reveal slam.

items.question: Do I have to step on the coin runes?
answer: No. Rolling through a tossed coin cancels it. If you ignore it, after about 10 seconds it spawns a Spirit of Balbala that adds pressure — cancel coins unless you want the add.

items.question: Why did Balbala's Barya not drop?
answer: The quest Barya drops only once, before your first Trial of the Sekhemas. If you already earned those Ascendancy Points, re-killing her yields nothing. A pre-0.2.1 bug causing no-drop was fixed in 0.2.1.

steps.label: Progress to Traitor's Passage

steps.label: Remove the Runic Seals
body: Enter the Prison of the Disgraced and remove the 3 Runic Seals to release Balbala; the fight begins at once.

sections.title: Encounter Overview
paragraphs: Balbala, the Traitor is a fast, teleporting djinn imprisoned in the Prison of the Disgraced. She is not a stat-check wall — she is a mechanics fight built around finding her while invisible, cancelling her coin summons, and dodging her blade patterns.

The kill itself is straightforward; the reward is the point. Defeating her drops Balbala's Barya, the quest version of a Djinn Barya that opens the Trial of the Sekhemas and grants your first 2 Ascendancy Points.
bullets: Locate her inside the poison gas instead of standing still.
Cancel coin runes by rolling through them unless you want the Spirit add.
The Barya is a one-time quest drop, not a repeatable reward.

sections.title: Poison Gas and the Hidden Boss
paragraphs: During the fight Balbala vanishes and spreads a Chaos/Poison gas from the arena center (cue: 'Mists of Sulamit!'). Standing in the gas is a steady damage-over-time that can kill you if you wait it out.
She is not gone — she is invisible in the cloud. Any damaging ailment or Contagion reveals her outline. Move into her to force the reveal slam ('Sands of Wrath!'), then punish the recovery.
bullets: Gas spreads from the center outward.
Contagion / ailment VFX reveals her position.
Approach her to force the reveal, then dodge the slam.

phases.label: Phase 1 — Continuous Fight
notes: No formal phase split; pressure comes from the poison-gas vanish and coin-run adds.

attacks.name: Whirling Blades
telegraph: Dash forward spinning, leaves an explosive AoE in her path that detonates after ~1.5s.
responses: Dodge sideways; do not stand in the spun path during the delay.

attacks.name: Coin Slam (Coin Toss)
telegraph: Tosses a coin that forms a rune on the ground.
responses: Roll through the coin to cancel it; if ignored, it spawns a Spirit of Balbala after ~10s.
notes: Untouched coins flood the arena with adds.

attacks.name: Spectral Blades
telegraph: Teleports and conjures blades that fire at you simultaneously (cue: 'Atul!').
responses: Time a dodge-roll as the blades launch.

attacks.name: Poison Daggers
telegraph: Throws several poisonous daggers in a line AoE.
responses: Roll repeatedly and flask to clear Poison stacks.

attacks.name: Poison Gas (Vanish)
telegraph: Turns invisible and spreads gas from center (cue: 'Visions of Jarah!').
responses: Reveal her with an ailment, approach to force the slam, then dodge.

sections.title: Reward Claim Flow — Balbala's Barya to Ascendancy
paragraphs: Killing Balbala drops Balbala's Barya (a quest-version Djinn Barya). This is the unlock, not the points themselves — you must run the Trial.

Take the Barya to the Trial of the Sekhemas: open the Desert Map from the Ardura Caravan, place the Barya in the Relic Altar (add Relics if you have them), clear the Trial rooms and Rattlecage the Earthbreaker, then use the Altar of Ascendancy to claim 2 Ascendancy Points.
bullets: Defeat Balbala -> Barya drops on the ground.
Open Desert Map -> Trial of the Sekhemas.
Place Barya in the Relic Altar.
Barya is one-time; later Ascendancies need random Djinn Barya drops.

rewards.label: Balbala's Barya
notes: Quest-version Djinn Barya; one-time. Opens the Trial of the Sekhemas for your first Ascendancy.

rewards.label: 2 Ascendancy Points
notes: Granted at the Altar of Ascendancy after clearing the Trial, not on the boss kill.

items.label: Cold damage / resistance
checks: Bring Cold damage if possible; she resists Fire.
items.why: She is weak to Cold and resists Fire.
items.fix: Cold rolls or a Cold skill.

items.label: Poison clearing
checks: Have a way to clear or avoid Poison.
items.why: Poison Daggers stack over a long fight.
items.fix: Flask with bleed/poison cleanse or movement.

items.label: Movement skill
items.why: Finding her in gas and cancelling coins needs mobility.
items.fix: Any movement skill or flask of speed.

items.label: Barya pickup space
items.why: The quest Barya drops on the ground.
items.fix: Free a slot before the kill.

sections.title: Build Considerations
paragraphs: Balbala rewards mobility and burst, not tanking. Melee must chase her through the gas; ranged can kite but still needs to reveal and pressure her.
Cold damage is the cleanest lever because she resists Fire. A Contagion or any damaging DoT also doubles as a tracking tool when she vanishes.
bullets: Melee: chase into the gas, punish the reveal slam.
Ranged: kite, but keep pressure so she cannot free-cast.
Any ailment reveals her while invisible.

entries.question: I lost Balbala's Barya and cannot enter the Trial
summary: Players report a softlock after failing the Trial or dropping the quest item.
editorialAnalysis: The Advisor NPC at the Trial lobby re-grants the quest Barya if the Trial was failed, so a true loss is recoverable.
officialAnswer: Talk to Balbala, the Advisor at the Trial of the Sekhemas lobby to re-obtain the quest Barya.

entries.question: Balbala is not dropping her Barya in Cruel
summary: Bug reports of no-drop, many confirmed; the no-drop behavior was fixed in 0.2.1.
editorialAnalysis: Current 0.5.4 drops the quest Barya correctly on the first Trial; re-kills after earning the points yield nothing by design.
officialAnswer: Defeating Balbala in Normal Traitor's Passage drops the quest Barya if you lack it or have not yet earned the points (fixed 0.2.1).

problems.symptom: I cannot see Balbala during the fight
directAnswer: She is invisible in the poison gas. Apply an ailment (Contagion works) to reveal her, then walk in to force the reveal slam.

problems.symptom: The arena is full of Spirits of Balbala
directAnswer: You let coin runes sit. Roll through each tossed coin to cancel it before the ~10s timer spawns a Spirit.
The quest Barya drops only once, before your first Trial. If you already have the Ascendancy Points, re-killing her gives nothing.
